I need to make a decision in this Monopoly turn.

I have $562 and both utilities. I am missing one orange property. p2 has $1326 and owns several yellows plus a light blue.

p3 controls all four railroads and owns pink and red properties. p4 recently bought States and now holds pink, yellow, green, and Boardwalk. The remaining unowned spaces are Baltic, Oriental, Virginia, New York, Kentucky, Atlantic, Pennsylvania, and Park Place. I will prioritize acquiring New York Avenue to complete the orange set. I must avoid selling Vermont or utilities to p2 or p3.

I cannot trade for New York Avenue because it is unowned. I must land on it to complete the orange set. The red set is split between me and p3, so I cannot easily finish that group either. I am weighing whether to trade or mortgage before ending my turn.

I am now mapping the exact color group ownership. p2 holds Connecticut and owns the light blue set. p3 owns St. Charles and Virginia. p4 owns States and North Carolina. I still need to land on New York Avenue to complete the orange set.

Green and dark blue are split between p2 and p4. No opponent has a color monopoly yet. p2 could complete the light blue set if I trade Vermont to them.

Trading with p3 would arm them with cash and not complete the red set. p4 cannot help since New York Avenue is unowned. The best path is to land on New York Avenue and build houses.

I have enough cash to buy New York Avenue and build three houses on the orange set. I will not mortgage utilities. I am now considering trading Indiana for another property that would block an opponent while still getting closer to a color set.

Breaking the four-rail monopoly is now a priority. I previously offered $500 for one rail, but p3 rejected it when they were poorer. They will not sell cheaply now that they have $1055. I am weighing whether to trade Indiana or Vermont plus cash for a railroad, though p3 would still lack Kentucky.

I decided against trading Vermont to p3. That would arm them with more assets without completing a color set. I will end my turn unless a clearly good trade appears.

I considered trading for p2's Connecticut to complete the light blue set, but they would not sell it while trying to finish that group themselves.
